top_categories.workout_context: 8,990ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
123ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Eroica Dolomiti's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
At Eroica Dolomiti, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
8,990ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.

Road-specific control matters at Eroica Dolomiti. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 73 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Eroica Dolomiti. Train it until it feels boring.
73 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Base fitness for Eroica Dolomiti. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Low-cadence force work supports 8,990ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 8,990ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.

race_overlay.weather: September in San Candido, South Tyrol, Italy. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Eroica Dolomiti. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Eroica Dolomiti's 73 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Eroica Dolomiti includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 73 miles of mixed terrain in San Candido, South Tyrol, Italy.
